notes: lane/idxclient: the client world keeps its own light as WorldClient does: PlayerInstance's flush after the server tick (fewer than 64 cells a chunk as S22/S23 the client relights, 64 as a partial S21 of the flagged sections, which takes the server's light at flush time and resets the chunk's relight cursor; writes without flag 2 are never sent), each received chunk's relight cursor, recheckGaps, and func_147456_g's relight rotation. play renders from this client world (frame_budget: 26 shots lowered, none raised). The random light check (lane/idxclient, second pass): with WorldClient.rand known (lane/clientgate's d.cw) its cell is vanilla's own, so the check runs exactly in the replay and in play (idx-cwcheck-s1). play draws this client world (its light) only while every check of it ran at a known cell (rw_from_cw); otherwise it draws the server's world, since the oracle's client light went through checks at unknowable cells (gold-g29-s42 at 2039: a pocket the client's check lit at 1878 stayed dark natively, 99,719 px, when drawn from the client world).
